body:
Hey @hajjoura11,

Did you see the guide on customisation on the website? Your idea seems very interesting, what data do you want to create the graph, is it created with the hits? If so, you can use [connectHits](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors/connectHits.html), what is also interesting is the stats about the current search, you can find those in [connectStats](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors/connectStats.html). 

Does that give you help? Feel free to continue asking more information 

guide on connectors: https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/guides/customization.html
